entries.15af36997d36f84b: A company that manufactures and sells manufacturing equipment for semiconductors and liquid crystal displays, printed circuit board manufacturing equipment, and precision molds and resin molded products.
entries.22e89b9c1d7bcf6e: This business develops, manufactures, sells and maintains process equipment for electronic device manufacturing, such as semiconductors and liquid crystal displays, and related peripheral equipment. The Semiconductor Equipment division handles coating equipment, developing equipment and equipment for advanced packaging, and its main product is the Wafer Support System compatible with various wafers. The Transfer Equipment division handles industrial robots that transfer wafers between semiconductor manufacturing processes and their units, the Cleaning Equipment division handles single-wafer cleaning equipment and batch immersion cleaning equipment, and the Coater division handles color filter manufacturing equipment for TFT color liquid crystal displays. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥27,475 million.

entries.acfe7ebd9ddd9bba: This business manufactures and sells precision molds for resin molding and resin molded products. Its main resin molded products are connectors for electronic devices and embossed carrier tape. Subsidiary Pretec Co., Ltd. manufactures molds and resin molded products, the company mainly sells them in Japan, and overseas Shanghai Longyun Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells resin molded products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,198 million.

entries.dd903819dbb91818: This business manufactures and sells equipment for printed circuit board manufacturing. Its main products are plating equipment and circuit formation equipment. A subsidiary of consolidated subsidiary Facility Co., Ltd. manufactures them, and they are delivered to China and other countries through Fulaide (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., and within Japan through Facility Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,754 million.
